chunks: Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام said:

"When the days of the season arrive, Allah, Blessed is Allah, Exalted is He, sends angels in the forms of human beings who buy the goods of the pilgrim and the merchants." It was said: "What do they do with it?" He said: "They cast it into the sea."
And it is narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿUthmān al-ʿAmrī, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said:
By Allah, the Master of this Affair surely attends the season every year. He sees the people and knows them, and they see him while they do not recognize him.

It is narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī that he said: I asked Muḥammad ibn ʿUthmān al-ʿAmrī, may Allah be pleased with him, and said to him: "Have you seen the Master of this Affair?" He said: "Yes, and my last meeting with him was at the Sacred House of Allah, while he was saying:
"O Allah, fulfill for me what You have promised me."
Muḥammad ibn ʿUthmān, may Allah be pleased with him and make him well-pleased, said:
And I saw him, may the blessings of Allah be upon him, clinging to the curtains of the Kaʿbah in al-Mustajār, while he was saying: "O Allah, take vengeance for me against Your enemies."

key_terms.أَسْتَارِ الْكَعْبَةِ: the coverings or curtains of the Kaʿbah
key_terms.الْمَوْسِمِ: the hajj season or pilgrimage period
key_terms.الْمُسْتَجَارِ: the place at the Kaʿbah known as al-Mustajār
key_terms.بَيْتِ اللَّهِ الْحَرَامِ: the Sacred House of Allah, the Kaʿbah
key_terms.صَاحِبَ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ: the Master of this Affair, referring to Imam al-Mahdi عليه السلام
key_terms.مَلَائِكَةً: angels sent by Allah in a special mission

ai.seo_question: What do Shia hadith say about Imam al-Mahdi during the hajj season?
ai.summary: This hadith reports matters connected to the hajj season, including angels appearing in human form and the continued presence of Ṣāḥib al-Amr during the pilgrimage. It also preserves supplications attributed to him at Bayt Allah al-Ḥarām, reflecting his hidden presence and his appeal to Allah for the fulfillment of the divine promise.
